questions.text: What does 'hygiene' mean?
questions.discussion: Hygiene means kebersihan or the practice of keeping ourselves clean.

questions.text: What is the English word for 'sabun'?
questions.discussion: Soap is used with water to wash our hands and body.

questions.text: What does 'germs' mean?
questions.discussion: Germs are tiny organisms that can cause illness.

questions.text: Which item do you use to wash your hands?
questions.discussion: Soap and clean water are used to wash hands.

questions.text: Look at the poster. What should you do after scrubbing your hands?
options: Rinse your hands with clean water
questions.answer: Rinse your hands with clean water
questions.discussion: After scrubbing, rinse your hands with clean water.

questions.text: Look at the poster. What is the first step?
questions.discussion: The first step shown is to wet your hands with clean water.

questions.text: Look at the poster. How long should you scrub your hands?
questions.discussion: The handwashing poster recommends scrubbing for about 20 seconds.

questions.text: Look at the poster. What is the last step?
questions.discussion: Drying your hands is the fifth and last step in the poster.

questions.text: Which sentence means 'Cucilah tanganmu'?
questions.discussion: Wash your hands is an instruction to clean your hands.

questions.text: Which word means 'membilas'?
questions.discussion: Rinse means membilas with clean water.

questions.text: What does 'brush your teeth' mean?
questions.discussion: Brush your teeth means menggosok gigi.

questions.text: What does 'comb your hair' mean?
questions.discussion: Comb your hair means menyisir rambut.

questions.text: What does 'clip your nails' mean?
questions.discussion: Clip your nails means memotong kuku.

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which habit is shown on the left?
questions.discussion: The first illustration shows a toothbrush and toothpaste for brushing teeth.

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which habit uses a comb?
questions.discussion: The comb is used to tidy or comb hair.

questions.text: Look at the picture. Which habit is shown with a shower?
questions.discussion: The shower picture represents taking a shower.

questions.text: Which action should you do before eating?
questions.discussion: Washing hands before eating helps remove dirt and germs.

questions.text: Your friend is coughing. What should your friend do?
options: Cough into the air near others
questions.discussion: Coughing into the inner elbow helps reduce the spread of droplets.

questions.text: You have a runny nose. What should you use?
questions.discussion: Use a tissue to blow your nose, then dispose of it properly.

questions.text: You are sick and must go to a crowded place. What should you do?
questions.discussion: Wearing a mask can help reduce the spread of respiratory droplets.

questions.text: Choose the correct advice: 'Kamu sebaiknya mencuci tangan.'
questions.discussion: After should, use the base verb wash.

questions.text: Complete: 'You should ___ your teeth.'
questions.discussion: The correct pattern is should + base verb: should brush.

questions.text: Complete: 'You should ___ your hair.'
questions.discussion: After should, use comb, not combs or combing.

questions.text: Which sentence gives good advice?
questions.discussion: You should use is the correct advice structure.

questions.text: Which sentence means 'Kamu sebaiknya tidak batuk ke temanmu'?
options: You shouldn't cough on your friends.
You should cough on your friends.
questions.answer: You shouldn't cough on your friends.
questions.discussion: Shouldn't gives negative advice and is followed by the base verb cough.

questions.text: Complete: 'You ___ wash your hands before eating.'
questions.discussion: Should is used to give advice about a good habit.

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
options: You shouldn't shares a dirty towel.
You shouldn't sharing a dirty towel.
You shouldn't share a dirty towel.
You not should share a dirty towel.
questions.answer: You shouldn't share a dirty towel.
questions.discussion: Shouldn't is followed by the base verb share.

questions.text: What does 'should' express in these lessons?
questions.discussion: Should is used to give advice or say what is a good idea to do.

questions.text: Which word means 'selalu'?
questions.discussion: Always means selalu.

questions.text: Which word means 'kadang-kadang'?
questions.discussion: Sometimes means kadang-kadang.

questions.text: Which word means 'tidak pernah'?
questions.discussion: Never means tidak pernah.

questions.text: What does 'twice a day' mean?
questions.discussion: Twice a day means two times each day.

questions.text: Which question asks about frequency?
options: How often do you brush your teeth?
questions.answer: How often do you brush your teeth?
questions.discussion: How often asks how frequently an activity happens.

questions.text: Choose the correct answer: 'How often do you brush your teeth?'
options: I usually brush my teeth twice a day.
I brush with my friend yesterday.
questions.answer: I usually brush my teeth twice a day.
questions.discussion: The question asks about frequency, so answer with usually and twice a day.

questions.text: Complete: 'I ___ wash my hands before eating.' (selalu)
questions.discussion: Always means selalu and fits the meaning in the sentence.

questions.text: Complete: 'I ___ take a shower every morning.' (biasanya)
questions.discussion: Usually means biasanya.

questions.text: Which sentence is about a daily hygiene habit?
options: I brush my teeth every day.
questions.answer: I brush my teeth every day.
questions.discussion: Brushing teeth every day is a personal hygiene habit.

questions.text: What should you do after playing outside?
options: Touch your eyes with dirty hands.
questions.discussion: After playing, wash your hands to remove dirt and germs.

questions.text: What should you do when you sneeze?
options: Cover your nose and use a tissue.
questions.answer: Cover your nose and use a tissue.
questions.discussion: Covering a sneeze and using a tissue helps protect people nearby.

questions.text: Which sequence word means 'pertama'?
questions.discussion: First means pertama and is used for the beginning of a procedure.

questions.text: Which sequence word means 'akhirnya'?
questions.discussion: Finally means akhirnya and introduces the last step.

questions.text: Choose the best order after wetting hands.
options: Dry, rinse, use soap, and wet.
Use soap, scrub, rinse, and dry.
Rinse, dry, and then use soap.
questions.answer: Use soap, scrub, rinse, and dry.
questions.discussion: After wetting hands, use soap, scrub, rinse, and dry.

questions.text: A: What should you do before going to school? B: ___
questions.discussion: The question asks for advice about a routine; I should comb my hair is correct.

questions.text: A: How often do you wash your hands? B: ___
options: I always wash my hands before eating.
questions.answer: I always wash my hands before eating.
questions.discussion: The answer describes frequency using always.

questions.text: Which instruction is correct?
questions.discussion: Dry your hands is an imperative instruction.

questions.text: What is the purpose of washing hands with soap?
questions.discussion: Soap and water help remove dirt and germs from hands.

questions.text: Which is a good personal hygiene habit?
questions.discussion: Wearing clean clothes is part of personal hygiene.

questions.text: Your hands are dirty, but lunch is ready. What should you do first?
options: Wipe them on a dirty shirt.
Wash your hands with soap and water.
questions.answer: Wash your hands with soap and water.
questions.discussion: Wash hands before eating, especially when they are dirty.

questions.text: Which sentence uses 'should' correctly?
questions.discussion: We should + base verb is the correct sentence pattern.

questions.text: Which sentence tells a habit that happens two times each day?
options: I brush my teeth twice a day.
I brush my teeth next year.
questions.answer: I brush my teeth twice a day.
questions.discussion: Twice a day means two times every day.

questions.text: A friend asks you to repeat an instruction. What can you say?
questions.discussion: Can you repeat, please? politely asks someone to say it again.
